$comment: Factory configuration. Lives at .factory/config.json in the target repo. Edit freely.

review.$comment: How second opinions are used. 'advisory' = reviewers critique, Claude reconciles, nothing blocks. 'blocking' = a CRITICAL finding pauses the pipeline and escalates.

budget.$comment: USD. 0 = unbounded (you will be warned). soft_pct warns, hard_pct pauses.

prices_per_million.$comment: Approximate list prices used to convert transcript token counts into dollars. Update as needed.

implementation.$pull_requests: per_feature = one pull request per feature, stacked in plan order (pr-stack.sh); single = one pull request from an integration branch.

standards.$comment: Engineering standards for the built project; see docs/engineering-standards.md there. Commands are filled in by F-001 once the toolchain exists. standards.sh install renders the git hooks from them; standards.sh check (and the implementation gate) verifies hooks, CI parity, naming rules and docs.

naming.$comment: Leave waiver empty unless the language has no supported naming linter; then name the ADR that records the equivalent.

license_policy.$comment: SPDX IDs. validate.sh licenses: deny blocks, ask and unlisted licenses need a human decision recorded in license_exceptions.

metrics.$comment: Targets the retro compares against (metrics.sh). Remove a target to stop tracking it.
